name: Editorial Mega Link
description: A giant editorial link row in clamp() display type with a long inline SVG arrow and a full-width bottom rule. On hover the arrow slides right, a thicker rule redraws from the left, and the text nudges along. Pure CSS, one anchor element, with a dark variant class.
usage: Include styles.css, then paste the anchor from index.html: an <a class="mega-link"> holding a .mega-link__text span and the inline SVG arrow. Add .mega-link--dark on dark backgrounds, and retheme or resize with the --ml-* custom properties.
source: Pattern seen on https://coffee-tech.com (Awwwards SOTD by MAKETHECUT and Or Halevi), implemented from scratch
